annual.debt_basis: total tag (LongTermDebt, long-term incl. current maturities; no short-term borrowings filed)

ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2025 DPS 0.36 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.1, 2026-06-30: 0.1) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.09, 2025-06-30: 0.09) — mixed basis: the full-year total is a paid fact and the quarters are declared facts, so the year-over-year change in the declared quarterly rate is applied to the paid total (a payment declared in one quarter and paid in the next can shift by a quarter)
dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2007-12-31..2026-06-30; paid FY facts for 4 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2022-12-31, 2023-12-31, 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31); both tags file quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30 and neither has stopped — declared is primary (paid becomes primary only when the declared tag has had no fact for 330 days while paid continues)
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2025-06-30, 2025-09-30, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

buybacks.basis: never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements

share_issuance.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements) − share_issuance NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements
legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

notes: dps_basis: declared facts for periods ending 2007-12-31..2026-06-30; paid FY facts for 4 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2022-12-31, 2023-12-31, 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)
annual_dps: FY2018, FY2019 = sum of the four filed quarterly DPS facts (no FY fact)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 0.36 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.1, 2026-06-30: 0.1) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.09, 2025-06-30: 0.09) — mixed basis: the full-year total is a paid fact and the quarters are declared facts, so the year-over-year change in the declared quarterly rate is applied to the paid total (a payment declared in one quarter and paid in the next can shift by a quarter)

frequency: the FY2025 total is a paid fact and the quarterly facts inside that year are declared facts — the payment count needs both from one tag, so the cadence is read from the spacing of the quarterly facts

buybacks_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed buybacks figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30) — the tag was never filed in any period, so the leg counts as zero
share_issuance_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed share_issuance figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30)
